messages:
Nadia: quick design huddle: updated mock for the playground run replay + compact tool panel. link: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/replay-compact.png

Chris: Love the idea of a lightweight replay scrubber. Proposal: one-line run rows with a tiny timeline scrubber when expanded. Keeps list short but gives quick access to replay.

AJ: For the collapsed row, can we show: model / primary tool / outcome / duration? Example:
[\u25b8] 2026-04-01 10:02 b7 gpt-4o / ExtractEntities b7 success b7 480ms
Chevron-focused when tabbing into row.

Samir: Copy nit: change top-left label from "Function defs" to "Tool definitions" and change the toolbar button text to "Tool examples & schema". Makes it clearer for product teams.\

Chris: Accessibility: scrubber must be keyboard operable (arrow keys) and announce timestamps as it moves. Use aria-valuetext="X seconds" and role=slider.

AJ: Implementation note: progressive hydrate streaming logs only when user expands or starts replay — avoids DOM cost. Pre-compute summary fields server-side for the list.

Samir: Schema editor examples: inline 1-line sample plus a "More examples" modal. Modal primary: "Insert example" (explicit). Also add per-snippet "Insert" tiny button with aria-label.

a11y-bot: Auto-scan: 4 issues found: chevron missing accessible name, scrubber missing slider semantics, low-contrast status chips, insert button lacks label. See: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/1870123456

Nadia: Keyboard shortcuts request: / to focus prompt, k to focus history search, r to start replay on focused run, e to expand. Add a small shortcut legend in the help overlay.

Chris: When replaying streamed generations, keep schema sidebar pinned and highlight the tool being called at each token boundary. For screenreaders, announce tool changes using a polite live region.

AJ: Quick UX question: default expanded view show pretty schema or raw JSON? I'm leaning pretty schema with a "view raw" toggle.

Samir: Pretty schema default. Provide headings for each property so SR users can navigate fields easily. Raw view must have role=region and aria-label="Raw schema".

Nadia: Action items:
- AJ: prototype collapsed rows + scrubber + progressive hydrate (due Thu)
- Chris: keyboard/screenreader replay flow docs + aria patterns (due Wed)
- Samir: copy pass for tool labels and modal CTAs (due Tue)
- a11y-bot: re-run scan after PRs and report

AJ: I'll upload a short prototype video when ready. Any objections to making the chevron the first tab stop?

Samir: ok with chevron-first. Also suggest small animation when inserting example so users see the editor update. Ensure it doesn't break SR focus.

Nadia: great. We'll review at the design sync Monday 9am. Thanks! :thumbsup:
